System

Shared time, lighting, weather and biome modifiers

Replicate a shared server clock epoch and weather state, then let clients render lighting and transitions locally. Fishing/resource modifiers read the authoritative weather/time version, not a client sky material.

Scope and player interaction

Replicate a shared server clock epoch and weather state, then let clients render lighting and transitions locally. Fishing/resource modifiers read the authoritative weather/time version, not a client sky material.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase17committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Clear → Overcast → Rain → Storm → Transitioning → Unavailable

WBP_HUD observes results from URPGWorldClockComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Weather_Rillmere. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
WorldTimeEpochUtc and GameDaySeconds: durable configuration; server time offset replicated
WeatherStateId, TransitionStart/EndServerSeconds and WeatherRevision
BiomeWeatherWeights: authored finite nonnegative values and allowed transitions
GameplayModifiersEnabled=false until tested
LightingCurveIds: sun intensity/color/fog parameters as cosmetic authoring
ScheduleTimeBucket: coarse shared clock view for later NPC schedules

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGWorldClockComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_HUDLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
GetAuthoritativeWorldTime() -> TimeSnapshot; server
SelectWeather(ZoneId, CycleId) -> WeatherTransition; server seeded policy
ApplyWeatherPresentation(Snapshot) -> LocalLighting; client
ResolveEnvironmentalModifier(ActionStartVersion) -> ModifierSet; server rules

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Zone initializes world epoch/cycle policy from backend/world configuration and publishes a compact synchronized time snapshot.
  2. Server selects a permitted biome weather transition and increments revision; clients interpolate light/fog/rain from accepted start/end.
  3. Gameplay action captures the relevant time/weather revision at its declared sampling point. Fishing pool modifiers do not change mid-transaction because a local rain effect loaded late.
  4. Late joiner receives current state and transition times, not a multicast history replay.
  5. Server restart resumes the persisted/derived cycle policy without multiple immediate weather events or reset exploits.
  6. NPC schedules may later consume time buckets, but core vendors remain recoverably accessible and no ecosystem simulation is required.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create DA_Weather_Rillmere with Clear/Overcast/Rain transitions and a day-light curve. Place BP_WorldClock once in each zone; authority publishes state through GameState/component.
  2. Create local lighting/weather presentation components with capped Niagara/emitter counts and scalability options. Keep weather visuals off dedicated-server render paths.
  3. Bind WBP_HUD to weather/time text/icon cues. Reopen fishing/resource definitions only when enabling specific modifiers with a versioned rule.
  4. Test midday/night, transition join, low effects setting and server restart using accelerated development clock values.
  5. Record real-world UTC versus game-time semantics in save schema; do not persist a different clock in each player SaveGame.

Reopen Phase17 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / ClockProbe / Weather_Rain / Water_Rill. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Client changes system clock -> no gameplay yield change.
Late join during storm -> same state/time interpolation, not clear until next event.
Weather definition missing -> safe Clear fallback for presentation and disable gameplay modifier with diagnostic.
Restart during transition -> consistent resumed/derived state, no repeated world-event reward.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed 60-minute game day, 10–20-minute weather dwell and no gameplay modifiers initially. Lighting/performance/readability must be tested on actual sprite materials.

Record clock offset error and weather revision, not per-frame sky values. Provide reduced weather particles/flashes and clear storm warnings without relying solely on sound.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
